test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). A is the immediate neighbour of D and F. F is the immediate neighbour of E and A. B is in the second position from the right end. If D is not at any of the ends, then how many persons are sitting towards the left of D?
solution:
Given: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F. 

1) B is in the second position from the right end.

2) A is the immediate neighbor of D and F. 

3) F is the immediate neighbor of E and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/356fea0245fa0a4b051aea703a532cad0cdc10b763d59001ecb0970ffb35c0fe.png] 

And, C will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f45f4f828d6a6483435acb3e464ce89555237e24637deb0f17074c0a18e2bda9.png] 

If D is not at any of the ends, then '**three**' persons are sitting towards the left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
